textRuns.value: Data & AI Platform Engineer (Independent projects) | Sep 2026 – Present | Fremont, California | USA

Overview: Building end-to-end data and AI projects on Microsoft Fabric platform using Lakehouse, warehouse, Apache Spark, SQL, Dataflow Gen2 and Claude AI to deepen my analytics engineering and AI-assisted BI skills

Fabric: Building Sales analytics solution on Fabric lakehouse and warehouse, from raw data to a governed Power BI semantic Model. The transformation of data performed using DataflowGen 2 and Python Notebooks prior beign loaded to Power BI which reduces semantic model refresh load.

Building agent workflow that automate repeatable BI tasks such as measure documentation, model audits and report QA.
Senior Data Analyst — Lumene Oy | June 2024 – Aug 2026 | Consumer Goods | Finland

Translated ambiguous business questions into workable data models — defining and validating measures and reconciling conflicting figures across SAP, Relex, and SharePoint with business stakeholders — and delivered end-to-end reporting solutions from requirements clarification to delivery.

Owned platform governance — naming conventions for datasets and reports, dataset and report architecture documentation, row-level security implementation by security groups, administered tenant, published data process documentation, access management, and data quality control — reducing data incident tickets by 30%.

Played a key role in an SAP S/4 Hana migration: redesigned and validated calculation logic for complex custom Z tables, led the transition of the on-premises data warehouse to a cloud platform, and developed new semantic models enabling seamless BI solutions.

Built organization-wide data capability: delivered Power BI training to commercial and operational teams across Finland and Scandinavia, created learning paths with 5 self-service BI courses on the corporate learning platform, and ran self-service BI workshops — training 20+ users and reducing dependency on the central data team.

Power Automate – Automated data extraction and distribution: Extraction of curated data from production Power BI semantic models, parsing and publishing outputs to a centralized SharePoint site — enabling secure, self-service data access for external guest users per custom business requirements.

Governance: Established the organization's Power Platform governance model; analysed license structure and usage across the tenant, built business cases for license procurement, and implemented DLP policies to standardize connector usage and secure the environment.

Implemented workflow layer around the data integration and low code application; Power App and Power Automate solutions that turned manual processes into self-service tools, by importing Excel upload that writes to backend database with the usage of premium connectors for R&D Team.
